dslRule:
<!id: junit.simplify.assertTrue.equals>
<!description: Replace org.junit.Assert.assertTrue(a == b) with org.junit.Assert.assertSame(a, b) for reference types or org.junit.Assert.assertEquals(a, b) for primitive types.>
<!severity: INFO>
org.junit.Assert.assertTrue($a == $b)
=> org.junit.Assert.assertSame($a, $b) :: instanceof($a, "java.lang.Object") && instanceof($b, "java.lang.Object")
=> org.junit.Assert.assertEquals($a, $b) :: otherwise
;;
summary: Replaces JUnit Assert.assertTrue for '==' comparisons with Assert.assertSame for reference types and Assert.assertEquals for primitive types.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
